name: Project 10 - Enterprise Knowledge & Workflow Agent Platform

parameters.query:
SELECT to_jsonb(u) AS user_row, $1::jsonb AS context
FROM public.enterprise_users u
WHERE u.user_id = ($1::jsonb ->> 'userId')
LIMIT 1;

WITH c AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j)
SELECT c.j AS context, to_jsonb(k) AS knowledge_row
FROM c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT chunk_id, document_title, section_title, required_role_tier, chunk_content
  FROM public.enterprise_knowledge
  WHERE required_role_tier = ANY (ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(c.j->'rbacContext'->'allowedTiers')))
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN chunk_content ILIKE '%' || (c.j->>'message') || '%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) k ON TRUE;

WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j), u AS (
 SELECT eu.user_id, eu.annual_leave_balance FROM public.enterprise_users eu, d WHERE eu.user_id=d.j->>'userId'
), ins AS (
 INSERT INTO public.employee_leave_requests (user_id,start_date,end_date,days_count,reason,status)
 SELECT u.user_id, (d.j->'leaveInput'->>'startDate')::date, (d.j->'leaveInput'->>'endDate')::date,
        (d.j->'leaveInput'->>'days')::int, COALESCE(d.j->'leaveInput'->>'reason','Leave request'), 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
 FROM u,d WHERE u.annual_leave_balance >= (d.j->'leaveInput'->>'days')::int
 RETURNING request_id,user_id,start_date,end_date,days_count,status
)
SELECT d.j AS context, to_jsonb(u) AS user_row, to_jsonb(ins) AS leave_row
FROM d LEFT JOIN u ON TRUE LEFT JOIN ins ON TRUE;

const row=$input.item.json; const ctx=row.context||{}; const t=row.ticket_row||{};
return {json:{...ctx,toolExecution:{toolName:'create_it_ticket',result:{...t,status:t.ticket_status||'OPEN',groundedAnswer:`IT ticket ${t.ticket_id||''} was created with ${t.urgency||''} priority. Status: ${t.ticket_status||'OPEN'}.`},executedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}};

const item=$input.item.json; const p=item.message||''; const m=p.match(/(?:for|of|about)\s+([A-Za-z0-9 &.-]+?)(?:,|\s+including|$)/i); const lookupName=(m?m[1]:p).replace(/\b(crm|client|account|health|details|contract|status|check|please|the|and|including|active|mrr|renewal|date|manager)\b/ig,' ').trim()||'Acme';
return {json:{...item,crmInput:{lookupName}}};

WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j)
SELECT d.j AS context, to_jsonb(c) AS client_row
FROM d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT client_id,client_name,contract_status,active_mrr,renewal_date,account_manager,tier
 FROM public.enterprise_crm_clients
 WHERE client_name ILIKE '%' || (d.j->'crmInput'->>'lookupName') || '%'
 ORDER BY client_name LIMIT 1
) c ON TRUE;

INSERT INTO public.agent_execution_audit (user_id,user_prompt,tools_invoked,agent_response,latency_ms)
SELECT NULLIF(d->>'userId',''), COALESCE(d->>'userPrompt',''), d->'toolsInvoked', COALESCE(d->>'agentResponse',''), GREATEST(COALESCE((d->>'latencyMs')::int,0),0)
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d) x
RETURNING audit_id, user_id, latency_ms, created_at;

parameters.content:
## Project 10 Supabase workflow starter
1. After import, select your Supabase Postgres credential on every Postgres node.
2. Seed enterprise_users, enterprise_knowledge and enterprise_crm_clients before testing.
3. Phase 9 currently uses httpbin.org/post for testing, not Slack/Teams delivery.
4. Leave requests are inserted as PENDING_APPROVAL. This starter deliberately does not auto-approve or deduct balances; connect a real manager approval callback before updating status/balance.
5. Knowledge retrieval here is role-filtered SQL retrieval, not vector similarity. Add embeddings + pgvector similarity search to meet the full RAG requirement.
6. This is a deterministic router scaffold, not a configured OpenAI AI Agent. Add your model and tools for full assessment compliance.
